credits.title: Credits
credits.keyfinder: The key estimate is a translation of libKeyFinder's method into Rust. libKeyFinder is Copyright 2011-2015 Ibrahim Sha'ath and the Mixxx contributors, GPL-3.0-or-later.
credits.ced: The audio model is CED-tiny by Xiaomi, Apache-2.0 (https://huggingface.co/mispeech/ced-tiny). Paper: Dinkel et al., "CED: Consistent ensemble distillation for audio tagging", ICASSP 2024. We converted it to ONNX with an extra output for the embedding; the weights are unchanged.
credits.audioset: The audio model's label names come from the AudioSet ontology (Google, CC BY-SA 4.0).
